description: Environment management, script context inspection, and global state control.

functions.name: current_script
functions.description: Returns the name of the currently executing LJE script, if any.

returns.description: The script name, or `nil` if no script is currently active.

functions.name: current_script_path
functions.description: Returns the full path of the currently executing LJE script, if any.

returns.description: The script path, or `nil` if no script is currently active.

functions.name: find_script_files
description: Searches for files matching `search_path` relative to the current script's directory. Returns `nil` if no script is active.
Supports wildcard patterns, so if you wanted to find all files in `detours/`, you would do `detours/*`.

params.name: search_path
params.description: A path pattern to search for, relative to the current script.

returns.description: An array of matching file path strings, or `nil` if no script is active.

functions.name: read_script_file
description: Reads the contents of a file relative to the current script's directory. Returns `nil` if no script is active or the file cannot be read.

params.name: relative_path
params.description: The path to the file to read, relative to the current script.

returns.description: The file contents as a string, or `nil` if no script is active or the file cannot be read. Binary files work as well.

functions.name: is_lua_involved
functions.description: Returns whether a Lua function is present in the call stack at or above the given frame offset.

params.name: frame_offset
params.description: The frame level to start checking from. Defaults to `1`.

returns.description: `true` if a Lua frame is involved at or above the offset.

functions.name: is_lje_involved
functions.description: Returns whether an LJE frame is present in the call stack, starting from `frame_offset` and searching up to `max_depth` frames.

params.name: frame_offset
params.description: The frame level to start checking from. Defaults to `1`.

params.name: max_depth
params.description: Maximum number of frames to search. Defaults to `-1` (unlimited).

returns.description: `true` if an LJE frame is found within the search range.

functions.name: is_lje_frame
functions.description: Returns whether the frame at exactly `frame_offset` is an LJE frame.

params.name: frame_offset
params.description: The frame level to check. Defaults to `1`.

returns.description: `true` if the specified frame is an LJE frame.

functions.name: show_special_frames
functions.description: Controls whether special (internal LJE) frames are visible in stack introspection. Useful when debugging inter-LJE interactions.

params.name: show
params.description: `true` to make special frames visible, `false` to hide them.

functions.name: on_cleanup
functions.description: Registers a per-script cleanup callback. The callback runs in the secure state when the game closes the main Lua state (e.g. on disconnect or shutdown), before LJE tears down its own resources. Requires an active script context, and only fires for secure scripts. Errors thrown by the callback are caught and printed to the console.

params.name: fn
params.description: Must be a Lua function, not a C function.

errors: Argument 1 must be a Lua function (not a C function).
